reason: A cloud-sync **scheduler** (interval, Wi-Fi/battery gating, exponential backoff, four conflict resolvers, metrics) whose transport does not exist: measured 2026-09-19, neither `proto/` nor `crates/amos-tauri` exposes any cloud/sync RPC — `lib/cloud.ts`'s "cloud" is a **local** snapshot (BACKUP_KEY) plus a pref, and `AccountPage` already says so in the user's words ("数据将快照为本地备份"). Wiring this scheduler to a local re-snapshot would make `totalBytesSynced` / `lastSyncSize` report a transfer that never happened — the exact "a number that lies" defect this repo hunts. Revisit when a real transport lands (daemon RPC or a host-side channel).

name: clearCellularRadio
reason: Teardown half of setCellularRadio. **Corrected 2026-09-25 (A6)**: the host it was waiting for now exists — `cellular_signal` (crates/amos-tauri/src/cellular.rs) reads `TelephonyManager`, and `lib/cellularHost.ts::installCellularSignal` installs it at Notification Center mount, so the sibling entry for `setCellularRadio` is gone. This one stays unwired because there is no honest moment to clear: the store holds the **device's** radio state, which does not stop being true when a window unmounts (the install effect re-reads on every remount anyway). A caller belongs here only if a radio source ever needs an explicit reset — e.g. a device whose SIM is removed while the shell runs and that wants the tile to fall back to 'no modem' rather than 'no signal'.
